data.exact_reserve_text: The significant movements in net claims incurred in respect of claims provisions created at the end of the previous period are analysed as follows:
data.standardized_narrative: At 31 December 2016 gross claims outstanding at the start of the year were GBP 36.521m. Analysis of the gross claims development triangle shows prior-year adverse development of approximately GBP 23.16m (strengthening), driven largely by development on the 2013 and 2014 underwriting years. The managing agent attributes movements to adverse claims development (notably in liability lines), IBNR recalibration and legal environment issues (notably Ireland), with reinsurance recoveries and exchange movements influencing the net position.
raw_causal_phrases: impact of a number of early losses
adverse results emanating from the Irish Republic due to the difficult legal environment
foreign exchange losses of GBP 3.3m arising from the syndicate's exposure to the Euro, and the strengthening of the Euro against Sterling during 2016 following the Brexit vote.
data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development was calculated from the gross claims development triangle (gross cumulative incurred comparisons) as no explicit gross 'movement in prior year's provision' line was provided. The triangle calculation excludes the two most recent UW years per guidance. Some class-level movement figures in the report are presented net of reinsurance; where only net class movements were available they have been used with lower confidence. Exchange movements and reinsurance to close activity noted elsewhere in the report may affect comparability.
